scope: Configuration-only supporting checks; not a live no-mistakes run or hosted CI execution
oracle: Accepted R1 decision: explicit successful no-op, no local fm-lint, retained hosted lint and Pi coverage
hosted_lint_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-lint"
bin/fm-lint.sh --partition "${{ matrix.partition }}of${{ strategy.job-total }}" \
  --telemetry "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-lint/partition-${{ matrix.partition }}.tsv"
pi_lane_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-test"
bin/fm-test-run.sh --lane portable-parallel-1 \
  --fail-on-gate-skip 'Pi extension typecheck prerequisite not found' \
  --json "$RUNNER_TEMP/fm-test/fm-test-timing-portable-parallel-1.json"
pi_selection_stdout:
tests/fm-pr-merge.test.sh
tests/fm-lint.test.sh
tests/fm-backend-herdr.test.sh
tests/fm-x-mode.test.sh
tests/fm-cd-pretool-check.test.sh
tests/fm-composer-lib.test.sh

tests/fm-send-settle.test.sh
